scope: Official product IDs with fetched UI entries and no compiled Rust product workspace route. Counts are IDs, not independent product models, UI designs, screens, or completed functional acceptance.

counting_rules.pending: ui_entry_found == true and product_id absent from Tab::for_product explicit routes and audited_mouse_mat entries
counting_rules.implemented: A nonempty compiled product workspace route plus mounted renderer; this does not claim complete conditional UI or working native services.
counting_rules.help: Help is a toolbar action for routed products, not an additional product ID.
counting_rules.pairing: Shared host pairing does not implement a dongle standalone Customize workspace or add a product route.
counting_rules.aliases: Preserve each catalog product_id and its original alias relations; do not claim IDs are unique models.
counting_rules.no_ui_entry: IDs without a fetched UI entry are excluded from pending UI count; unavailable endpoints do not establish a missing product interface.
counting_rules.navigation: Preserve the catalog navigation owners, actual component expressions, source offsets, display_mode and reachability. Flattened name counts are only an index, not a claim of identical screens.
counting_rules.legacy_modules: Unregistered src/features/*.rs files do not count as compiled interfaces.

family_rules_in_order.rule: categories intersects KEYBOARD or KEYPAD and does not contain SYSTEM
a category starts with AUDIO or equals BROADCASTER_MICROPHONE
a category starts with IOT_ or equals HUE or HUE_HUE
all remaining raw categories, including productCategoryIcon; no inference from product name

verification.navigation_extraction: Existing catalog AST evidence retained; all referenced current JS hashes checked again for this audit.
verification.code_complete: From the source catalog receipt validation; full resource download/completeness was not rerun for this coverage audit.
